escenas.texto: Which was the most viewed video in Africa this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, This Paper Lets You Cook a Full Meal With Zero Cleanup, by Brain Pits, with over 8 million views.
In second place, Ranking Funniest Waterslide Moments, by SunsetCroc, with over 13 million views.
And number one: How a Snowdrift Becomes An Igloo, by From The Ground Up, with over 20 million views.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
